notes.title: Beard of Stone 1.0.1
notes.content:
Changelog:
- Added a Display that shows whose turn it is, and what portion of the turn is being taken. This can be turned off in the Graphics options menu.
- Fixed bug when stone circle occupant has no racial structure to return to (they will move to a random adjacent hex instead)
- Edited Tutorial Text to make some passages more clear.
- Fixed a bug where Tutorial Text/Graphics were not appearing in front of other game assets.
- Slowed down the default Game Speed.
